scenes.voiceText: The system prompt is pinned in memory, so the next request can reuse it instantly.

sceneDirection.narrativePurpose: Show how the reusable prompt prefix is stored and reused instead of being resent.
sceneDirection.visualIntent: The viewer sees a large prompt block lock into a memory rail, then a smaller request reuses the same block.
sceneDirection.visualMetaphor: A luminous data cartridge docks into a glass memory rail; the next packet takes a fast path through the stored cartridge.

camera.path: Track the cartridge as it slides into the rail, then arc toward the returning request packet.

depthLayers: glass memory rail and data particles
cartridge and request packet in foreground
composition.negativeSpace: Keep lower quarter free for word-synced captions; labels appear beside the rail, never over the cartridge.

visualEvent.setup: A long prompt cartridge floats outside an empty memory rail.
visualEvent.action: The cartridge docks and locks; a second request packet approaches and branches through the stored prefix.
visualEvent.payoff: The prompt cartridge remains lit while only the new request packet continues, showing reuse.

elements.purpose: Represents the reusable static system prompt.

appearance.form: translucent lavender cartridge filled with short data glyphs

elements.motionRole: Slides from left, rotates into the rail, locks with a physical snap.

appearance.form: long illuminated glass rail with empty slots
appearance.palette: deep purple with violet edge lights

elements.motionRole: Rails illuminate slot-by-slot as the cartridge docks.

elements.purpose: Shows a later request reusing the stored prefix.

appearance.form: small chartreuse packet with trailing particles

elements.motionRole: Moves along the rail and exits through a fast side path after the cache hit.

choreography.pathOrChange: Move left-to-right, rotate 12 degrees into alignment, then settle into the rail.

causeAndEffect.reaction: The rail slots illuminate in sequence and the lock indicator turns lime.

soundCue.purpose: A tactile latch sound marks successful storage.

choreography.pathOrChange: Travel along the illuminated rail, branch into the fast exit lane and accelerate out of frame.
choreography.purpose: Show that the stored prefix is reused rather than transmitted again.

causeAndEffect.reaction: The cartridge stays lit while the packet exits on the fast path.

soundCue.purpose: A short whoosh emphasizes the low-latency reuse path.

audio.voiceSegment: The system prompt is pinned in memory, so the next request can reuse it instantly.
audio.ambience: Quiet low-frequency server-room tone, kept subtle.
audio.musicCue: Build light tension during docking, resolve into a restrained bright pulse on reuse.
audio.ducking: Narration remains clearly foregrounded; duck music and ambience beneath every spoken phrase.

captions.anchor: lower-center safe zone outside the rail's moving foreground
captions.treatment: Large white word captions with one lime-highlighted active word; no panel/card background.

transition.continuityReason: The outgoing request packet becomes the entering fast-path packet in the next scene.
